title: Sundance 2027 Episodic Alfred P. Sloan Science Grant
summary: A $17,000 grant plus creative support for an original half-hour or one-hour series that illuminates a historical figure, event or area of science. Submissions go through FilmFreeway; the program page lists a waiver code for the fee.
costLabel: Fee waiver code listed on the program page
deadlineNote: Sundance's deadlines page lists December 3, 2026; the program page lists December 14, 2026 with the waiver code. Use the earlier date.
eligibility: Original series about a historical figure, event or area of science (medicine, energy, mechanics, technology, mathematics, invention).
